title: ר' תנחום דמן פרווד

paragraphs: R' Tanhum of Parvod, Bar Kappara's pupil. R' Yohanan came to Parvod and asked, “Is there anything from Bar Kappara's teaching?” R' Tanhum of Parvod taught him. Rashi explains that Parvod was Bar Kappara's locality: Avodah Zarah 31a.
